what: The worked skeleton from references/wireframe-conventions.md §10, drawn correct-by-conventions: header and footer bands spanning the frame, a segmented control with one primary tab, two KPI tiles, and two chart cards holding declared chart and table placeholders.
why: The clean baseline. Every role here is either structural or declared, so this fixture must score zero on both fallbacks and inferred — if it ever does not, inference has regressed on a drawing that follows the conventions exactly.
notes: The screen carries no label of its own; the name is derived from the 26px heading inside the header band.
